_readme: SHOW FORMATS — candidates, not the enforced bank. A show format borrows a whole kind of entertainment the viewer already watches: its roles, its big moment, its voice, its sound, its ending. It is a FORMAT by the house test (the script and who carries it both change); the visual STYLE is still picked separately from styles/bank.json. Brand injection is the ROLE MAP: the same six roles in every show, filled by the brand's avatar, problem, product, mechanism and offer. Nothing here is a format profile yet — a row Damon picks gets written from formats/TEMPLATE.md into formats/bank.json. `who_watches_hypothesis` is a guess to be checked against the sub-avatar's own feed, never a finding.

roles.name: The hero
roles.what: the customer — always her, never the brand

roles.name: The villain
roles.what: the problem, given a name, a face and a personality

roles.name: The move
roles.what: the product, used the way this show uses its biggest moment

roles.name: The voice
roles.what: whoever this show lets explain things — they carry the mechanism so the hero never has to lecture

roles.name: The replay
roles.what: the place this show naturally zooms in or slows down — that is where the mechanism scene lives

roles.name: The verdict
roles.what: how this show ends — that is the offer

shows.name: Fight night
shows.what: A championship bout, called live by two ringside commentators.
shows.why_it_works: The commentators can say anything about the product and it sounds like excitement, not a pitch. The fight gives the problem a body to lose.

roles.hero: the challenger, walking out to her own music
roles.villain: the undefeated opponent — the problem with a fighter's name
roles.move: the finishing move: she pulls out the product and locks the opponent up
roles.voice: two ringside commentators, one hype, one analyst — the analyst explains the mechanism mid-hold
roles.replay: the slow-motion replay: zoom into the opponent fading, down to what the active ingredient is doing underneath
roles.verdict: the belt, 'and NEW…', the offer on the broadcast lower-third

shows.sound: crowd roar, bell, walk-out music, commentators talking over each other
shows.frame_prompt: a championship fight broadcast frame: she stands in a fight ring in fight gear, confident, facing a towering shadowy opponent made of dark blotchy pigment; arena spotlights, crowd, two commentators at a ringside desk in the foreground corner, broadcast score bug

shows.name: Cooking show
shows.what: A warm kitchen-counter show where the host makes the thing in front of you.
shows.why_it_works: Her trust in a recipe transfers to the product: ingredients you can see, steps you can follow, a result you can taste.

roles.hero: the host at her own counter
roles.villain: the recipe that always fails — the thing everyone gets wrong
roles.move: the secret ingredient, added with a flourish
roles.voice: the host to camera, plus a sidekick who asks the questions the viewer would
roles.replay: the overhead close-up: the mixture changing colour and texture in the bowl
roles.verdict: the reveal plate and the recipe card — the offer is the recipe card

shows.sound: sizzle, studio audience warmth, gentle theme sting
shows.who_watches_hypothesis: women 50+; daytime TV and recipe-reel watchers
shows.frame_prompt: a daytime cooking show frame: she stands behind a bright studio kitchen counter in an apron, presenting a mixing bowl of golden paste to camera, ingredients in small glass bowls, overhead camera rig visible, warm studio audience lighting, show logo-free lower third

shows.name: Soap opera
shows.what: Daytime drama: long stares, a secret, someone who was supposed to be gone comes back.
shows.why_it_works: The problem that 'keeps coming back' is literally a soap plot. She already knows the grammar — the return, the reveal, the cliffhanger.

roles.hero: the woman who has been wronged
roles.villain: the one who keeps coming back — the ex, the twin, the rival; the problem returning in the same place
roles.move: the reveal: the truth she produces at the dramatic moment
roles.voice: inner monologue and the confidante in the next scene
roles.replay: the soft-focus flashback: how it came back last time, and why
roles.verdict: the cliffhanger — 'find out' is the call to act

shows.sound: swelling strings, a held pause, a door
shows.who_watches_hypothesis: women 50+; (telenovela is a variant for Spanish-speaking households, not a second format)
shows.frame_prompt: a daytime soap opera frame: she turns from a mantelpiece in an over-decorated living room with a dramatic shocked stare, soft glamour lighting, shallow focus, a shadowy figure standing in the doorway behind her, melodramatic mood

shows.name: Home shopping hour
shows.what: A live sell on a shopping channel: host, demo table, caller on the line, clock ticking.
shows.why_it_works: It is the one show that is ALREADY a direct-response ad, and her generation bought from it for thirty years.

roles.hero: the caller on the line who already owns it
roles.villain: the old product on the demo table that did not work
roles.move: the live demo on the back of a hand
roles.voice: the host, and the caller's own words
roles.replay: the split-screen close-up of the demo hand
roles.verdict: the countdown clock and 'quantity remaining' — the offer, natively

shows.sound: phone line beep, host patter, soft bed music
shows.frame_prompt: a television home-shopping channel frame: she sits as host at a glossy demo table showing the back of her hand to camera, product jars arranged on risers, on-screen graphics with a countdown clock and a phone icon, bright flat studio light

shows.name: Courtroom TV
shows.what: Small-claims television: a plaintiff, a defendant, a judge with no patience.
shows.why_it_works: A judge can say 'that product never worked and you knew it' — a verdict lands harder than a claim.

roles.villain: the defendant: the thing she tried that failed her
roles.replay: the evidence photo, enlarged on the easel
roles.verdict: the gavel — judgment for the plaintiff, the offer as the ruling

shows.frame_prompt: a daytime courtroom television frame: she stands at the plaintiff's podium holding up an evidence photograph, a stern judge at the bench behind, wood-panelled courtroom, flat bright TV lighting

shows.name: True-crime documentary
shows.what: A hushed investigation: evidence board, archive footage, the culprit hiding in plain sight.
shows.why_it_works: 'It was never what you thought it was' is the mechanism-led argument wearing a trench coat.

roles.hero: the one who would not let it go
roles.villain: the culprit everyone overlooked — the real cause
roles.move: the piece of evidence that cracks it
roles.voice: the hushed narrator and the expert interview
roles.verdict: case closed — the offer as 'what she uses now'

shows.sound: low drone, tape hiss, a single piano note
shows.frame_prompt: a true-crime documentary frame: she studies an evidence board covered in photographs and red string in a dim room lit by a desk lamp, film grain, serious investigative mood

shows.name: Game show
shows.what: A bright studio, a host, a big board, a contestant who has been wrong before.
shows.why_it_works: Every product she already tried becomes a wrong answer on the board — the objections get handled as a game.

roles.villain: the wrong answers: everything she tried
roles.replay: the board flipping to reveal the answer

shows.frame_prompt: a classic television game show frame: she stands at a contestant podium mid-cheer under colourful studio lights, a big answer board behind her with covered panels, a host in a suit gesturing, confetti

shows.name: Home makeover
shows.what: Before, demolition, rebuild, the walk-through reveal.
shows.why_it_works: Two steps — strip the old surface, rebuild what is underneath — is exactly how a renovation is told.

roles.villain: the 'before' — what was hiding under the surface
roles.verdict: the reveal walk-through — the offer at the front door

shows.sound: sledgehammer, upbeat montage music, the gasp
shows.who_watches_hypothesis: women 35–65; home and garden channel watchers
shows.frame_prompt: a home renovation show frame: she stands in a half-renovated bathroom in work gloves beside a contractor, one wall stripped to studs and the other freshly tiled, bright natural light, before-and-after energy

shows.name: Nature documentary
shows.what: A calm famous-sounding narrator observes a creature doing what it does.
shows.why_it_works: The narrator can describe skin, a cell or an ingredient as wildlife — the mechanism becomes a story with an animal in it.

roles.hero: the creature we are rooting for
roles.verdict: the season turns — the offer as the closing line

shows.sound: orchestral swell, wind, the narrator's hush
shows.frame_prompt: a nature documentary frame: extreme macro wildlife cinematography of her hand resting on moss as if it were a landscape, tiny glowing golden particles moving across the skin like creatures, shallow depth of field, soft forest light

shows.name: Sports analyst desk
shows.what: Two analysts at a desk arguing over a replay, drawing on the screen.
shows.why_it_works: Us-versus-them staged as a debate, and the telestrator is a licence to draw the mechanism on a freeze-frame.

roles.hero: the player having the comeback season
roles.villain: the rival — or last season's version of him
roles.move: the play that changed the game
roles.replay: the telestrator: circles and arrows drawn on the frozen replay
roles.verdict: the final score graphic — the offer

shows.sound: desk banter, whoosh graphics, highlight music
shows.frame_prompt: a sports television analyst desk frame: two animated analysts in suits argue at a glossy studio desk, a large screen behind them shows a frozen close-up of a hand with yellow telestrator circles and arrows drawn on it, broadcast graphics

shows.name: Boss fight
shows.what: A video-game level: health bars, a boss, a power-up, 'level cleared'.
shows.why_it_works: A health bar is the clearest progress picture ever invented — the problem visibly loses hit points.

roles.villain: the boss, with a name and a health bar
roles.voice: the on-screen text and the announcer voice
roles.replay: the boss's health bar draining while the hit lands
roles.verdict: level cleared, loot drop — the offer is the loot

shows.frame_prompt: a retro video game boss battle screen: she appears as the player character facing a huge blotchy shadow boss, health bars at the top of the screen, a glowing power-up item floating between them, game HUD
